# WO-132: App accessibility sweep (offline browser)
Status: open (bulk backlog; Nora dispatches in her own order, WIP 5)
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_CODEX.md)
Assigned to: Codex channel session (Nora dispatches)

## Goal
Start the local wizard/dashboard in-process with fake data (see existing tests/test_wizard_a11y.py for the harness) and, for every screen: keyboard-only reachability of every control, visible focus, one h1, labelled fields, no positive tabindex, 200% zoom without sideways scroll at 1280px. Do not duplicate existing assertions; cover screens they miss.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New test files only, named `test_cx_*.py` / `test_cp_*.py` (unique basenames across tests/). Offline, no new dependencies.
- A real product bug: strict xfail on that case only, with a reason naming the file:line, reported in VENDOR_STATUS.md. Never change `src/`.
- Run the new tests and ruff on your files and report real numbers.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths (no scratch, backup or .new/.tmp copies).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/codex/test_cx_app_a11y_sweep.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/, every existing file not listed above, every other lane in docs/BACKLOG.md.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md when done; the team lead summarises in the channel.
